model: ROLEX Oyster Perpetual 41 134300 (41 mm steel, sunburst blue dial, Oyster bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Oyster Perpetual 41 template (the pistachio, sunburst blue, beige and lavender 134300 dials change model, note, trace, dial_map, steel_map, dial emission and, if the pose differs, the hands section): case and lugs from the photo silhouette, smooth domed polished bezel, domed crystal, baton hands and a seconds needle, fluted crown and the three-column Oyster bracelet (outer / centre / outer) at the photo's joints; the dial, indices, print, minute track and the photographed hands come from one native photo map. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 21.805 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug top y 918 = 23.2 mm, lug bottom y 1970 = 25.04 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: smooth domed polished bezel (no insert, no numerals): fractions of bezel_in..bezel_out (18.07..20.27 mm) from the inner edge to the outer edge

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, from perpendicular edge scans on the photo (the silhouette includes the black side facet) plus 0.03 mm so the 3D hands hide the photographed ones; the last point sits at the measured length (flat tips). The lume strips and black facets stay in the projected photo. Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: plain fluted Rolex crown, no guards: neck x 1399..1410, flutes to x 1455, rounded cap to 1477 (coronet is texture)

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet: brushed outer links and a wider centre link. Joints (px, 21.805 px/mm, pivot (961, 1424)): outer top 759.5 / 923, bottom 1987 / 2171 / 2363 / 2500; centre top 727 / 868.5, bottom 2025.5 / 2236 / 2410 / 2507; ends y 673 (top) and 2526 (bottom). The photo's own dark lines and shading stay in the projected texture. Column x lines top 855.5 / 1055.5 px, bottom 856..858 / 1059..1062.5 px. The centre column starts at 18 mm under the bezel; outer pieces start at the case tips. Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette (the bracelet tapers 21.6 mm at the lugs to 16.5 mm at the end).

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
